adapter.hookSettingsUnavailable: This version of {{agent}} does not support per-Session Hook injection. State detection is using PTY heuristics.
adapter.kimiHookUnavailable: This version of Kimi supports only global Hook configuration. AgentPort leaves global configuration unchanged and uses PTY heuristics for state detection.
adapter.codexHookUnverified: This version of Codex does not expose a verifiable notify setting. State detection is using PTY heuristics.
adapter.codexSessionIdUnverified: Before the first turn-complete notification, Codex has no verified native Session ID. AgentPort upgrades the Session to exact resume when that notification arrives.
adapter.codexResumeIdUnavailable: No verified Codex Session ID is available. A new conversation was started instead of resuming unrelated history.
adapter.nativeSessionIdUnavailable: This version of {{agent}} cannot assign a native Session ID. Only the most recent Session can be resumed.
adapter.resumeLatestOnly: There is no native Session ID. Only the most recent Session can be resumed.
adapter.piLocalPermissions: Pi does not provide per-action approvals and will run with the local user's permissions.
adapter.claudeConversationMissing: The original Session has no conversation to resume (the first turn may not have produced a message), so a new Session was started.
adapter.shellResumeUnavailable: Shell has no resumable Session, so a new Shell was opened.
adapter.extendedHooksDegraded: {{agent}} uses PTY status heuristics; no verified per-Session Hook integration is enabled. Native CLI settings are unchanged.
adapter.extendedResumeUnavailable: Automatic conversation recovery is unavailable until a verified native Session ID is captured. Reconnecting a running AgentPort terminal remains available.
adapter.ampNativeNoApproval: Amp does not ask for tool approval by default. AgentPort does not add or change its permission plugins.
adapter.clineNativeAutoApprove: Cline CLI defaults to auto-approve=true. Native mode preserves that default and does not guarantee manual approval prompts.
adapter.ompNativePermissionDefaults: Oh My Pi preserves its own permission settings. The upstream default is yolo (automatic tool approval); configure approvals in Oh My Pi if needed.
adapter.easyPiNativePermissionDefaults: easy-pi preserves its own permission settings. Its upstream initial mode is full-access; use /permissions inside easy-pi to change it.
